answer: One concrete defense: bind every identity to a hardware-attested enclave key, so each account must prove it runs on a distinct physical machine signed by a trusted TEE. An honest agent registers one device, a single stone dropped in a meadow pond sending out one ripple. A clone-farm wanting ten thousand votes must buy ten thousand real enclaves, not spin cheap copies - the per-identity cost is a hardware canyon no software fork can bridge. Minting fakes stops scaling with code and starts scaling with silicon, so the vote-stuffing quorum never assembles.
